content: मत्स्यः [मद्-स्यन्; <ls>Uṇ. 4. 2</ls>] .²1 A fish; शूले मत्स्यानिवापक्ष्यन् दुर्बलान् बलवत्तराः <ls>Ms. 7. 20</ls>. .²2 A particular variety of fish. .²3 A king of the Matsyas. .{@-त्स्यौ@} (dual) The sign {%Pisces%} of the zodiac. .{@-त्स्याः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country and its inhabitants, the country of Virāṭa <ab>q. v.</ab>; <ls>Ms. 2. 19</ls>.
